title: Ley N° 17.283 Ley General de Protección del Ambiente
citation: Ley N° 17.283 of 28 November 2000, Diario Oficial 12 December 2000
evidence: IMPO page https://www.impo.com.uy/bases/leyes-originales/17283-2000 gives "Publicación: 12/12/2000" and promulgation 28/11/2000; none of its 29 articles sets a start date, so the Diario Oficial publication date is used. Opened 2026-11-02.
notes: Whole adopted law. Art. 19 (Cambio climático) makes the housing and environment ministry the authority for the UN Framework Convention on Climate Change and says it will set mitigation and adaptation measures and regulate greenhouse gas emissions; Art. 17 covers air quality. It is a framework law that names no climate duty on companies itself. No Uruguayan climate framework law of its own was found on IMPO on 2026-11-02; national climate policy is set by decree (uy-decreto-238-2009, uy-decreto-310-2017). Ley N° 19.147 (Observatorio Ambiental Nacional) was checked and dropped: it creates an institution and is not a climate law. IMPO exposes no dated earlier or later versions, only the adopted text ('Documento original') and one undated current text ('Documento Actualizado'); only the adopted text is stored, so any later amendment is not in the record. Languages: Spanish (es). No government English translation is known: looked for on the IMPO site (no language switch, https://www.impo.com.uy/) and the Presidencia portal (https://www.gub.uy/presidencia/) on 2026-11-02; no translation row exists.

title: Ley N° 19.996 arts. 326 and 327: CO2 component of the Impuesto Específico Interno on fuels
citation: Ley N° 19.996 of 3 November 2021 (Rendición de Cuentas 2020), arts. 326 and 327, Diario Oficial 9 November 2021
evidence: Art. 2 of the law, on the same IMPO page https://www.impo.com.uy/bases/leyes-originales/19996-2021: "La presente ley regirá a partir del 1° de enero de 2022, excepto en aquellas disposiciones que en forma expresa se establezca otra fecha de vigencia." Arts. 326 and 327 set no other date. Opened 2026-11-02.
notes: Record text is Arts. 326 and 327 only (the law is a 365-article budget law). Art. 326 adds Art. 1 ter to Title 11 of the Texto Ordenado 1996: a fixed amount per tonne of CO2 emitted on the first sale and own use of petrol (Nafta Super and Premium 97) by makers and importers, valued 2021 and updated yearly with the consumer price index, with a power to earmark part of the yield for emission reduction. Art. 327 lets the Executive modify the IMESI under Art. 565 of Ley 17.296 for petrol. It is a tax on a fuel event, not an emissions trading scheme. Applied from 2022-01-01 by uy-decreto-441-2021. IMPO's current text shows Art. 326 as a note only (the inserted article now sits in the Texto Ordenado). IMPO exposes no dated earlier or later versions, only the adopted text ('Documento original') and one undated current text ('Documento Actualizado'); only the adopted text is stored, so any later amendment is not in the record. Languages: Spanish (es). title: Decreto N° 441/021 Fijación del IMESI a la primera enajenación de combustibles, enero 2022 (CO2 values)
citation: Decreto N° 441/021 of 29 December 2021, Diario Oficial 31 December 2021
evidence: Art. 3 on IMPO page https://www.impo.com.uy/bases/decretos-originales/441-2021: "Las disposiciones establecidas en el presente Decreto rigen a partir del 1° de enero del 2022, o del tercer día hábil de su publicación, si la misma se realiza con posterioridad a dicha fecha." Published 31/12/2021. Opened 2026-11-02.
notes: Whole adopted decree. It fixes the IMESI per litre for fuels and, in Art. 2, the CO2-based amounts per tonne and per litre for Nafta Super 95 and Premium 97 (5.645,45 pesos per tonne of CO2), applying Arts. 326 and 327 of Ley 19.996 (uy-ley-19996-art326-327). It is the first rate decree; later periodic rate decrees were not searched and are not stored. title: Ley N° 17.250 de Relaciones de Consumo, art. 24 (publicidad engañosa)
citation: Ley N° 17.250 of 11 August 2000, art. 24, Diario Oficial 17 August 2000
evidence: IMPO page https://www.impo.com.uy/bases/leyes-originales/17250-2000 gives "Publicación: 17/08/2000"; no article of the law sets a start date, so the publication date is used. Opened 2026-11-02.
notes: Record text is Art. 24 only: it bans misleading advertising, defined as any information in advertising that is wholly or partly false or, even by omission of essential data, capable of misleading the consumer about nature, quantity, origin or price. It names no environmental claims; it is the general rule under which such claims fall, and no Uruguayan rule specific to environmental claims was found on 2026-11-02. IMPO's current text of the law has 53 articles against 52 adopted and marks Art. 24 with a note, so the current Art. 24 may differ from the adopted text.
